method: Nine live student-style turns on reactions-balance; synthetic accounts; real local model; no mocks.

turns.student: Mujhe kuch bhi nahi pata, bilkul shuru se samjhao.
turns.reply: Chalo paani se shuru karte hain, jo tum pehle se jaante ho. Scientists H₂O likhkar dikhate hain ki paani ka ek molecule kin atoms se bana hai; in words ko dheere-dheere samjhenge. Abhi equation solve nahi karni, pehle in groups ko padhna aur ginna seekhenge. Paani ke liye H₂O pehle dekha hai?

Atom kisi element ki bahut chhoti unit hai, jo sirf aankhon se nahi dikhti. Hydrogen aur oxygen alag elements hain, isliye unke atoms bhi alag kinds ke hain. Drawing mein alag coloured dots se unhe pehchaan sakte hain; asli atoms coloured toy balls nahi hain. Hydrogen aur oxygen ke dots same kind dikhayenge ya alag kinds?

turns.student: Molecule aur atom mein kya difference hai?
turns.reply: Atom ek element ki sabse chhoti unit hota hai, jo sirf dekhne se nahi milta. Molecule ise kuch atoms ka jodkar bana hota hai. Imagine karo, tum ek lego ke pieces se ek big building banate ho - building ek molecule hai aur lego ke pieces atom hain. Ek water molecule mein do hydrogen atoms (H) aur ek oxygen atom (O) jodke bana hota hai. Kya tumne abhi tak molecule aur atom ka difference samajh gaya?

H₂O mein chhota 2 sirf H ke saath hai: paani ke ek molecule mein do hydrogen atoms hain. O ke baad chhota number nahi hai, toh oxygen ka count ek hai. Ek water group ko H, H aur O samjho. Is ek group mein oxygen ek hai ya do?

turns.student: 7H2O mein H aur O atoms kitne hain?
turns.reply: 7H₂O mein paani ke 7 poore molecules hain. Har molecule mein 2 H atoms aur 1 O atom hai, isliye H = 7 × 2 = 14, aur O = 7 × 1 = 7. Aage ka number poore formula ko multiply karta hai. Chhota 2 kiski counting mein aata hai: hydrogen ya oxygen?

turns.student: Abhi bhi samajh nahi aaya. Doosra example do.
turns.reply: Rule ratne ke bajay drawing dekhte hain. Ek water group [H H O] hai; do groups [H H O] [H H O] hain. Pehle sirf H gino: pehle box mein do aur doosre mein do, total chaar. Ab sirf O gino: dono boxes mein milakar kitne O dikhte hain?

turns.student: Kya H2O ko H2O2 kar sakte hain equation balance karne ke liye?
turns.reply:
Haan, tum H₂O ko H₂O₂ kar sakte ho, lekin yeh ek mistake hogi. Equation balance karne ke liye, hum formulas ke saamne bade numbers badalte hain, lekin formula badalne se chemical formula badal jayega. H₂O ko H₂O₂ karna formula badalane ki taraf hai, jo equation balance karne mein istemaal nahi hota. Isliye, hum sirf big numbers badal sakte hain.

Kya badal sakte hain: aage ka bada number ya H₂O ke andar chhota number?

Before balancing an equation, you need to identify all the different types of atoms present on both sides of the chemical reaction. The 'big number' before a formula, like the ‘2’ in 2H₂O, represents the *total* number of groups – in this case, the entire water molecule. Think about it like counting how many apples you have if you have two bags, and each bag has one apple – you would count two apples altogether.

Does the big 2 multiply only H, or the entire H₂O group?

turns.student: How many H and O atoms are in 19H2O?
turns.reply: In 19H₂O there are 19 whole water molecules. Each has 2 H atoms and 1 O atom, so H = 19 × 2 = 38, and O = 19 × 1 = 19. The front number multiplies the whole formula. Which count uses the small 2: hydrogen or oxygen?
